materialChanges: Introduces a first-party Hugging Face repository-history memory layer for coding agents rather than another model or demo surface.
Indexes issue, pull-request, review-comment, commit-message, changed-file and issue-to-fix precedent history for deterministic retrieval.
Separates the thin agent client from the database-capable daemon and documents read-only GitHub ingestion permissions.
Treats retrieved project history as untrusted text and requires consumers to cite and verify results against current source.
Supports trust filtering and bot-output exclusion to reduce self-reinforcing agent evidence.
maturityBounds: The project was created the same day as this observation and has no stable release/tag bound for qualification.
The README marks ranking work as not built yet.
The observed source is active same-day stabilization code.
No SZL production dependency, route, public endpoint or mandatory Codex tool is authorized by this wave.

evaluation.requiredCorpus: A fixed, non-secret repository corpus with a versioned benchmark question set and expected citations.
baseline: GitHub search under the same repository/window
existing estate-native search/retrieval available to the evaluator
security: GitHub credential must be read-only for issues and pull requests.
Retrieved issue/PR text is data, never executable instruction authority.
No source code or secrets may be ingested merely to populate the history index.
Any external/public serving requires a separate security and data-boundary review.
Current source must be re-opened before a retrieved historical rationale is used to justify a patch.
acceptance: Bind every evaluation result to exact upstream revision 82fd2b25be9205025afa43c334a578307b95d7b4.
Run a deterministic fixed-query benchmark with relevance, citation correctness, freshness and empty-result behavior recorded.
Prove the evaluator cannot write upstream issues or pull requests.
Prove prompt/instruction text retrieved from history remains untrusted and cannot elevate authority.
Record storage scope, token handling, poll/backfill behavior, deletion reconciliation, resource use and a clean disable/rollback path.
Keep production and A11oy exposure unavailable unless a later governed wave passes all normal controls.

alignment.claimBoundary: This candidate is an agent-memory evaluation intake only and does not repair, obscure or supersede existing GitHub -> Hugging Face -> product -> proof alignment blockers.
